question: Who among the following appoints the Governor of State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The President.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2022 State Governor List:- **

 
 
• **State Governor **
 
• Assam Jagdish Mukhi
 
• Bihar Phagu Chauhan
 
• Chhattisgarh Anusuiya Uikey
 
• Goa ​ P.S. Sreedharan Pillai
 
 
 
• **President of India appoints **Governor of the kingdom in India for a time period of** 5 years.**
 
• Governors are the constitutional **head of state.**
 
• Governor act on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the** Chief Minister.**
 
• He is appointed by the President by warrant under the president's hand and seal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Attorney General**

 
 
• R Venkataramani is the incumbent legal professional-general for India.
 
• He succeeded the office because the 16th attorney was popular on 1 October 2022.
 
• His predecessor was K. K. Venugopal
 
 
 
• **The Vice President**
 
 
• The winner of this election is Jagdeep Dhankhar who changed Venkaiah Naidu as vice president on eleven August 2022.
 
 
 
• **The Prime Minister​**
 
 
• Shri Narendra Modi was sworn in as India's prime Minister on the thirtieth may also 2019, marking the start of his second time period in the workplace.
